summary: Provides rendering logic and formatting utilities to generate text strings representing file summaries, exported symbols, and sub-directories within directory concept pipelines.
responsibilities: Render file summaries and export symbol inputs into formatted text strings, and provide sub-directory rendering capabilities.
relationships: The directory provides rendering functions that process file summaries, export symbols, and sub-directories into formatted string outputs.
design_decisions: Uses functional rendering approaches to convert context structures into formatted string representations.
